Basketball.name: Basketball
Basketball.summary: A Basketball variant of pong exclusive to the Atari 2600 as games 45-46 of the launch title Video Olympics. The game features a simple game of one-on-one basketball playable by one or two players, one of the few early Atari 2600 to have a true single player feature with an AI-controlled opponent.

Video Pinball.name: Video Pinball
Video Pinball.summary: Video Pinball is a loose simulation of an arcade pinball machine: ball launcher, flippers, bumpers, and spinners.
